name: library-management

scripts.dev: npm run build:kit && concurrently --kill-others --names kit,api,app --prefix-colors blue,magenta,green "npm:dev:kit" "npm:api" "npm:dev:app"
scripts.build: npm run build:kit && npm --prefix apps/library-app run build
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:kit && npm --prefix packages/resource-kit run typecheck && npm --prefix apps/library-app run typecheck
scripts.verify: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run check:cycles && npm run check:boundaries && npm --prefix apps/library-app run build && npm run build-storybook && npm run check:consumer

//: Scripts use npm --prefix rather than -w: npm 9.6.x exits 0 when a workspace script fails, which would hide failures in verify.
